# fastyfold

> Admin panel for FastAPI over async SQLAlchemy 2.0 (or SQLModel) models. Server-rendered (Jinja2, htmx, Alpine), no Node. Built-in users, roles, audit log, CSV export, optional JSON API. Public API: `Admin`, `ModelAdmin`, `action`. Python 3.10+.

This file is for coding agents writing code that *uses* fastyfold. It is also installed with the package: `python -c "import fastyfold, pathlib; print(pathlib.Path(fastyfold.__file__).parent / 'llms.txt')"`.

## Install

```bash
pip install "fastyfold @ git+https://github.com/yeakiniqra/fastyfold@v0.3.0"
pip install aiosqlite        # or asyncpg / aiomysql: the async driver for your database
```

## Minimal setup

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import create_async_engine
from fastyfold import Admin

engine = create_async_engine("sqlite+aiosqlite:///app.db")   # must be async; a URL string also works: Admin("sqlite+aiosqlite:///app.db")
app = FastAPI()

admin = Admin(engine)
admin.register(Order, Customer)      # plain models get sensible defaults
admin.mount(app)                     # at /admin; admin.mount(app, "/backoffice") for another path
```

First visit to `/admin` redirects to `/admin/setup`. fastyfold prints a one-time code (`fastyfold setup code: XXXX-XXXX`) to stdout; entering it creates the owner account. No secret key, no login code needed. fastyfold creates its own `fastyfold_*` tables on the first request; never create them yourself.

## Customizing a model

```python
from fastyfold import ModelAdmin, action

@admin.register
class OrderAdmin(ModelAdmin):
    model = Order                                   # required
    group, icon, key = "Shop", "receipt_long", "o"  # rail group, Material Symbols name, G+key shortcut
    name, name_plural, slug = "Order", "Orders", "order"   # defaults come from the class name
    list_display = ["id", "customer", "customer.email", "status", "total", "margin"]  # columns, relation, relation.column, or a method
    column_labels = {"total": "Amount"}
    search_fields = ["note", "customer.name"]
    list_filter = ["status", "created_at", "customer_id", "total"]   # choice/bool/date, fk, number range
    ordering = "-created_at"
    per_page, per_page_options = 25, [25, 50, 100]
    board_field = "status"                          # a choice/Enum column; enables the Board view
    choices = {"status": ["new", "paid", "shipped"]}
    colors = {"paid": "#10b981"}
    form_fields = ["customer_id", "status", "total", "note"]
    readonly_fields = ["total"]
    exclude = ["secret"]                            # never shown on the form, never written
    fieldsets = [("Shipping", ["address", "city"])]
    inlines = ["items"]                             # or [("items", ["product_id", "qty"])]: one-to-many children
    file_fields = {"photo": "image"}                # String columns holding uploads; needs Admin(media_dir=...) or storage=
    preview_fields = ["status", "note"]
    export_fields = ["id", "status", "total"]
    schema = OrderIn                                # optional Pydantic model, validated after field parsing
    save_as = True
    select_all_limit = 1000

    def margin(self, obj) -> str:                   # computed column: sync, (self, obj), returns display value
        return f"{obj.total - obj.cost:.2f}"

    @action("Mark shipped", icon="local_shipping", key="s", confirm="Ship them?")
    async def mark_shipped(self, session, objs):    # objs: list of records; changes commit with the audit entry
        for o in objs:
            o.status = "shipped"
```

## Hooks (override on ModelAdmin)

| Method | Sync/async | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `get_query(self, request) -> Select` | sync | Row scoping for every list, count, export, lookup, record and API call. Start from `super().get_query(request)`; user is `request.state.admin_user` |
| `has_permission(self, user, perm) -> bool` | sync | `perm`: `view`, `add`, `change`, `delete`, `export`, or an action method name |
| `has_object_permission(self, user, perm, obj) -> bool` | sync | Same, for one record |
| `save(self, session, obj, is_new)` | async | Inside the transaction; default `session.add(obj)` |
| `delete(self, session, obj)` | async | Inside the transaction; default `await session.delete(obj)` |
| `after_save(self, obj, is_new)`, `after_delete(self, obj)` | sync or async | After commit |
| `label(self, obj) -> str` | sync | How a record is named everywhere |

## Admin options

```python
Admin(
    engine,                    # AsyncEngine or async database URL
    authenticate=None,         # None: built-in users. Or `async def (username, password) -> str | None` (must be async)
    secret_key=None,           # None: generated and stored in the database
    owners=None,               # with your own authenticate: usernames with full access; others need roles
    permission=None,           # global sync (user, perm, model_admin) -> bool
    title="Admin", accent="#ff6a2b", logo_icon="layers", groups={"Shop": "shopping_bag"}, site_url=None,
    login_attempts=10, secure_cookies=None, cookie_path=None,
    media_dir=None, storage=None, max_upload=10 * 1024 * 1024,
    templates_dir=None,        # your templates first; extend "original/fastyfold/<name>.html"
    api=False, api_auth=None,  # JSON CRUD at /admin/api/{model}; api_auth is a FastAPI dependency returning the user
)
```

## Pages, widgets, your own routes

```python
from markupsafe import escape

@admin.page("Reports", icon="bar_chart", group="Insights", key="r")
async def reports(request, user):          # return HTML str (inserted unescaped into the layout), a Response,
    return f"<p>Hi {escape(user)}</p>"     # or admin.render(request, "my/report.html", **ctx). POST forms need
                                           # <input type="hidden" name="_csrf" value="{admin.csrf(request)}">

@admin.widget("Revenue", icon="payments", span=4)   # span: 3, 4, 6, 8 or 12
async def revenue(session, user):          # AsyncSession; return number/text, {"value", "caption"},
    return {"value": 1200, "caption": "today"}      # [(label, n), ...] for bars, or None to hide

from fastapi import Depends
@app.get("/me")
async def me(user: str = Depends(admin.current_user)):   # Admin(cookie_path="/") to share the session with app routes
    return {"user": user}

await admin.end_sessions("nusrat")         # sign a user out everywhere
```

## Rules and common mistakes

- **Async only.** `create_engine` (sync) does not work; use `create_async_engine` with an async driver (`sqlite+aiosqlite`, `postgresql+asyncpg`, `mysql+aiomysql`).
- **Single-column primary keys only.** Composite keys are not supported.
- **Register models, pages and widgets before `admin.mount(app)`.**
- **No lazy loading.** Async sessions can't lazy-load. Many-to-one relationships of the model itself are preloaded, but a related object's own relationships are not, so `label()` and computed columns should read plain columns (or relationships named in `list_display`).
- **Slugs are unique.** Models and pages share one namespace (default: lower-cased class name). Reserved: `login`, `logout`, `static`, `api`, `setup`.
- **Built-in users have roles on.** A new non-owner user sees nothing until an owner gives them a role (Roles screen). Owners see everything.
- **Every check must pass:** `Admin(permission=)`, role grants, `has_permission`, `has_object_permission`, and `get_query` for visibility.
- **Escape page HTML.** Strings returned from `@admin.page` are not escaped.
- **Not SQLAlchemy?** SQLModel works as-is. For Tortoise, Piccolo, Peewee or raw SQL, write SQLAlchemy classes mirroring the existing tables just for the admin (don't `create_all`). MongoDB/Redis aren't supported.
